summary: Iteration 17: Testing 6 WINEK profile corrections. Found and fixed 2 bugs: (1) missing @router.post decorator on create_user_review causing 405 Method Not Allowed, (2) edit-review-btn/my-review-banner not showing due to auth context timing race condition (me=null when loadReviews runs). Both fixed. All 20 backend tests pass. All frontend features verified working after fixes.

critical.issue: Missing @router.post decorator on create_user_review function. The function existed but was not registered as a route, returning 405 Method Not Allowed on all POST requests.
critical.status: FIXED by T1 - added @router.post('/{user_id}/reviews') decorator in /app/backend/routes/user_routes.py

ui_bugs.issue: edit-review-btn and my-review-banner not showing on page load. Root cause: useFocusEffect fires when id is set, calling loadReviews() while me (auth context user) is still null (auth context is restoring from stored token asynchronously). Since me is null, the review.reviewer_id === me.user_id check never runs, leaving myReview null.
ui_bugs.status: FIXED by T1 - added useEffect([me?.user_id, reviews]) to re-detect myReview when me loads after reviews are fetched

ui_bugs.issue: Button text 'Voir les 1 autres avis' has French plural agreement error when count=1 (should be 'Voir le 1 autre avis'). Minor copy issue.

action_items: FIXED (T1): POST /api/users/{id}/reviews missing @router.post decorator - now returns 409 for duplicate, 201 for new reviews
FIXED (T1): edit-review-btn/my-review-banner timing bug - added useEffect to re-detect myReview when auth context loads
MINOR: Fix French plural 'Voir les 1 autres avis' → 'Voir le 1 autre avis' (singular handling) in see-more-reviews-btn text
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: create_user_review function in user_routes.py was missing @router.post decorator - the function was defined but not registered as any HTTP route

FIXED: Race condition in [id].tsx - useFocusEffect with [id] dependency captures loadReviews closure that closes over me=null. Added reactive useEffect([me?.user_id, reviews]) to re-detect myReview when auth context loads
The useFocusEffect dependency array should arguably include me?.user_id to reload when user changes, but the new useEffect approach is safer and avoids double-fetching
Star picker in edit form (StarRow component) uses TouchableOpacity without testID or role attributes, making it untestable via data-testid/role selectors

rca_of_the_issue:
Bug 1 RCA: In /app/backend/routes/user_routes.py, the create_user_review function at line 179 was missing the @router.post('/{user_id}/reviews') decorator. The function was syntactically correct Python but not registered as any HTTP route - causing ALL POST requests to the path to return 405 Method Not Allowed. Fix: added the decorator.

Bug 2 RCA: In /app/frontend/app/user/[id].tsx, the useFocusEffect fires with [id] dependency when the screen mounts. At this point, the AuthContext is still restoring the user from stored token (async /auth/me call). The loadReviews() function captures the me variable from the component closure where me=null, so the data.find(r => r.reviewer_id === me.user_id) comparison is never executed. Result: myReview stays null, showing 'Laisser un avis' form instead of 'Mon avis' banner with Modifier button. Fix: added useEffect([me?.user_id, reviews]) that re-detects myReview reactively whenever me becomes available after reviews are loaded.
